question:
Consider the function
\[
f(x)=\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{\log_e(2+x)-x^{2n}\sin x}{1+x^{2n}},\qquad x>0.
\]
(i) Is \(f(x)\) continuous at \(x=1\)? Justify your answer.

(ii) Show that \(f(x)\) does not vanish anywhere in the interval \(0\le x\le\pi/2\), and indicate the points where \(f(x)\) changes its sign.
